sloka: व्यक्तं रामोऽभिषेकार्थमिहायास्यति धर्मवित् ।इति सूतो मतिं कृत्वा हर्षेण महता वृतः ॥२-१४-६६॥
transliteration: vyaktaṁ rāmo'bhiṣekārthamihāyāsyati dharmavit ।iti sūto matiṁ kṛtvā harṣeṇa mahatā vṛtaḥ ॥2-14-66॥

translations.english: So thought the charioteer and filled with great delight left (the inner apartment), eager to see the mightyarmed Rama.
